newsitem.title: USA: Smith Corona says begins trading on Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Smith Corona says begins trading on Nasdaq.

text.p: Smith Corona Corp said its common stock began trading on the Nasdaq small cap market Thursday.
A company spokesman said Smith Corona has just emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy status.
The spokesman said its stock previously traded on the electronic bulletin board and over the counter. Warrants for Smith Corona stock will continue to trade over-the-counter.
Smith Corona Corp makes portable electronic typewriters, personal word processors, and related accessories and supplies.
